headline: Executive Order 13621 creates a White House Initiative on Educational Excellence for African Americans.
what_it_does: This 2012 order sets up a White House initiative focused on education for African Americans. No summary was provided, so the details of its structure, duties, and any advisory groups are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The initiative is aimed at the education of African American students, though the specific programs or changes are not described in the title.
